name: Moving Averages
summary: This EA is a classic moving average crossover system that generates buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average, and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It opens positions based on these crossover events and typically includes configurable MA periods and lot sizing. The strategy is a foundational trend-following approach suitable for trending markets.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个经典的均线交叉系统，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，快速均线下穿慢速均线时产生卖出信号。它基于这些交叉事件开仓，通常包含可配置的均线周期和手数设置。该策略是基础的趋势跟踪方法，适用于趋势市场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于均线交叉策略，属于经典趋势跟踪类型。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线的金叉做多、死叉做空，信号产生于均线方向变化的那一刻。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定的止损/止盈水平，部分版本可能包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，默认手数较小，缺乏根据账户余额动态调整的机制。资金管理方面较为简单，没有动态风险比例计算或资金曲线保护逻辑。整体策略逻辑清晰易懂，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on a moving average crossover strategy, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are a golden cross (fast MA crossing above slow MA) for buy signals and a death cross (fast MA crossing below slow MA) for sell signals, triggered at the moment of crossover. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, with some versions potentially including trailing stop functionality. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with a small default lot size, lacking dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management is relatively simple, with no dynamic risk ratio calculation or equity curve protection logic. The overall strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, but it tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和验证
参数可配置性强，用户可自定义均线周期和手数
趋势市场中表现良好，能够捕捉中长期趋势行情
代码结构规范，适合作为学习MQ5编程的入门范例
包含风险比例和减仓因子参数，提供基本资金管理框架
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
High configurability with customizable MA periods and lot sizes
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing medium-to-long-term trends
Well-structured code, suitable as a beginner example for learning MQL5 programming
Includes risk ratio and decrease factor parameters providing a basic money management framework
cons: 震荡市场中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏高级过滤机制如ADX趋势强度或多时间框架确认
固定手数模式不够灵活，未根据波动率动态调整仓位
止损止盈设置不够完善，默认值可能为零导致风险敞口过大
无新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks advanced filtering mechanisms such as ADX trend strength or multi-timeframe confirmation
Fixed lot sizing is inflexible, not dynamically adjusted based on volatility
Stop-loss and take-profit settings are inadequate, default values may be zero leading to excessive risk exposure
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加ADX或趋势强度过滤器，在震荡行情中减少虚假信号
加入多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性
实现基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理
improvements_en: Add ADX or trend strength filter to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing

risk_points: 默认止损可能为零，存在无限亏损风险
无新K线检查，可能在一根K线上多次开仓导致过度交易
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不适时入场
震荡市中连续虚假信号可导致资金回撤较大
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss may be zero, creating unlimited loss risk
No new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions on a single bar causing overtrading
Lacks spread filter, may enter trades inappropriately during high-spread conditions
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets can cause significant drawdown
